meta.how: cell = median over the runs of that ephemeris whose lead lands on that target year; empty before the release; band = DE440 against DE442 at the target

composite.note: mass-weighted mean of the bodies' errors (weights: DE440 GM; the giants as their systems). Jupiter and Saturn carry 92 % of it.

composite_body.note: median over the ten bodies, each counted once

sky.units: arcsec on the sky, median of |observed minus predicted| over the window's observations
sky.how: each body is propagated by our engine from one fixed start and never re-fitted; every new month of Minor Planet Center observations scores that ageing prediction and JPL's own for the same instants

curves.b: our propagation from JPL's state at the epoch
